recommendation.choice: nullable persisted Problem.questionGroupKey plus indexes plus database invalidation trigger plus one current-gate server question projection
recommendation.reason: avoid full current-content proof on every broad-view count while preventing stale grouping after any identity-affecting edit
recommendation.schemaFree: Correct if every caller uses current strict proof before group/count/page; externalId unique index alone does not index format-stripped grouping; not the recommended default path

keyDecision.hash: lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(string tuple), collision checked in proof manifest
keyDecision.normalization: No semantic, numeric, whitespace or seed/variant integer normalization; omit only format; whole external ID must match; unproven rows remain singleton

strictProof.content: MC is exact SA rstrip prefix plus five terminal lines numbered ①②③④⑤; do not use normalized OCR parser output as identity
strictProof.answer: MC answer is exactly one circled number 1..5; selected option trim exactly equals SA answer trim; SA answer is not circled choice number
strictProof.eligibility: Independent per row; reviewStatus/directUseAllowed/pool do not grant sibling eligibility; grouping proof independent of row gate

invalidation.trigger: BEFORE UPDATE; actual IS DISTINCT FROM change in any proof field, externalId or questionType clears NEW.questionGroupKey even if key supplied in same update
invalidation.backfill: current pair reread in one transaction; proof then compare-and-set key-only update both members or roll back; preserve existing updatedAt and content; source manifest alone is not current proof

scopeUpdateFromCoordinator.reinforcementCeilingForFutureRecalculati: maximum 96 actual contents; not included in current snapshot projection

snapshotCensus.policy: Only exact accepted engine external key SA/MC pairs plus matching metadata, base stem, answer selected by MC, solution and complete figure payload digests; every unproven row remains singleton.
